q: How does a steel galvanising unit near Wardha work out its CBAM figure?
title: Wardha galvanising unit CBAM figure
short: Galvanised coil or sheet is a CBAM steel good. Its figure is the embedded emissions of the coil you bought, plus your own direct emissions from furnace and annealing fuel. Zinc is not a precursor. Electricity is not charged for steel goods, but keep it on record.
audience: Cold rolling and galvanising units in Wardha and the Vidarbha belt

ul: Coil supplier's embedded emissions per tonne.
Fuel for annealing and zinc pot heating.
Tonnes of coil in and product out, for yield.

p: Scrap and trim losses mean more coil per tonne of product, which raises the figure.
Without their figure, your importer falls back on default values for the precursor.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, power and production records into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions your EU importer asks for.
